## Charge Smarter


### Explore EV business rates


NH business customers are eligible for EV TOU Rates. MA business customers are eligible for Electric Vehicle (EV) Demand Charge Alternative Rates.


[Learn more about EV commercial rates →](https://unitil.com/time-of-use/ev-tou)


## Case Studies


### Your success is our success


Every day, we partner with businesses in our communities to help drive economic development and sustainable energy practices. Will your company be next?


[See how businesses have saved →](https://unitil.com/for-businesses/case-studies)


## Safety & Preparedness


### Safety puts people first


What’s in your building? Knowing more about your energy systems and how they’re maintained can help you ensure the safety of your customers and employees.


[Learn ways to stay safe →](https://unitil.com/safety-preparedness)


## Economic Development


### Building a Main Street that thrives


Our commitment to the cities and towns we serve extends to the businesses and industries vital to our local economies.


[Learn how we work with the communities we serve →](https://unitil.com/our-company/economic-development)
